transcript: First preheat the oven to 180 degrees and grease the cake tin. Whisk the eggs with sugar until pale, then fold in the flour and a pinch of salt.
The pasta water needs to be salty like the sea. Add the garlic to olive oil on low heat and wait until it turns golden before adding the tomatoes.
Remember to buy basil, parmesan and fresh lemons. The recipe for the risotto says stir every few minutes and add the stock one ladle at a time.
Marinate the chicken in yogurt, cumin and paprika overnight. Grill it over medium coals and let it rest before slicing so the juices stay inside.
The bread dough doubled in size after two hours. Shape the loaves, score the top with a sharp knife and bake in a hot dutch oven with the lid on.
Chop the onions finely and sweat them in butter for ten minutes. Add thyme, a splash of wine and reduce the sauce until it coats the spoon.
Dinner plan for Friday: fish tacos with lime slaw, black beans and a quick mango salsa. Keep the tortillas warm wrapped in a towel.
Soak the lentils overnight, then simmer them with bay leaves and carrots. Season with vinegar at the end, never at the start, or they stay hard.
Our flight to Lisbon lands at nine in the morning, so we need a taxi to the hotel near the old tram station. Passports are in the blue pouch.
The train from Florence to Rome takes about ninety minutes. Book the seats by the window and validate the paper ticket before boarding.
Hotel check in was smooth, but the room faces the highway. Ask reception for a quieter room on a higher floor when we come back from the beach.
Packing list for the trip: sunscreen, a light rain jacket, two swimsuits, the travel adapter and the printed visa confirmation.
At the airport the boarding gate changed twice. We ran through the terminal with the backpacks and just made the connecting flight to Oslo.
The hostel in Kyoto had bunk beds and a shared kitchen. Breakfast was rice, miso soup and tea, and the staff gave us a map of the temples.
Rental car pickup is at the desk past baggage claim. Check the tyres and the fuel level before driving out of the airport onto the motorway.
Sunset at the coastal village was spectacular. We walked along the harbour, took the ferry back across the bay and missed the last bus home.
Quick sync on the quarterly roadmap. Priya will own the billing migration and the team agreed to review the deadline again next Thursday.
Action items from the standup: finish the API review, update the client deck, and send the revised budget to finance before the board call.
The product review went well. Stakeholders asked for a dashboard showing weekly active users and the churn trend by region.
Hiring update: we have two final round interviews this week and the offer letter for the senior engineer needs legal sign off on Monday.
In the retro we discussed the sprint scope. Too many tickets were carried over, so we will limit commitments and track blockers in the channel.
Client call notes: they want a proposal for the renewal, a timeline for the integration, and a named point of contact for escalations.
Reminder to submit the expense report and the quarterly forecast spreadsheet. Manager approval is needed before the end of the month.
Board preparation: the slides need the revenue bridge, the headcount plan, and an appendix covering the vendor contract renegotiation.
Run log: five kilometres in thirty two minutes, legs felt heavy on the hill. Next week add intervals on the track and a longer cool down stretch.
Squats at sixty kilos, three sets of eight, then deadlifts with a slow eccentric. Rest ninety seconds between sets and keep the core tight.
Morning mobility routine: foam roll the calves, hip openers, and ten minutes of stretching before the gym session starts.
Swim session today was forty lengths of freestyle plus drills for the kick. My breathing on the left side still needs work during the sprint.
Heart rate stayed in zone two for the whole bike ride. Recovery days matter, so take a rest day after the long run and sleep at least eight hours.
Protein target is about 140 grams a day. Add a shake after training and track the macros in the app to keep the cutting phase on schedule.
Yoga class tonight focused on balance and breathing. The instructor cued the warrior poses and a long hold in the pigeon for the hips.
Marathon training plan: long run on Sunday, tempo on Wednesday, easy miles the rest of the week. Increase weekly mileage by no more than ten percent.
The tomato seedlings need more sun and a deeper pot. Water them at the base in the morning so the leaves stay dry and mildew does not spread.
Planted the garlic cloves in the raised bed in October. Mulch the soil with straw and check the compost pile for worms next spring.
The roses got aphids again. Spray with soapy water, prune the damaged stems and keep the ladybugs happy by skipping the pesticides.
Compost bin is full of kitchen scraps, dry leaves and grass clippings. Turn it every two weeks so the pile heats up and breaks down.
Sowed carrots and radishes in rows. Thin the seedlings to five centimetres apart once they reach a few leaves and keep the bed weeded.
The lawn needs mowing on a higher setting, and the hedge trimmer is blunt. Buy fresh blades and fertiliser for the borders before autumn.
Dug up the potatoes today, the harvest is good. Store them in a dark cool shed and check the bin for rot every week through winter.
Herb garden update: basil and mint doubled in size, the parsley bolted, and the rosemary by the path needs a hard prune after flowering.
Practised the scales on the piano for twenty minutes. Left hand still lags behind in the arpeggios, so slow the metronome to sixty and repeat.
Guitar lesson notes: barre chords on the fifth fret, strumming pattern down-down-up-up-down, and the bridge section of the new song.
Recording session for the demo: drums first, then bass through the amp simulator, and finally the vocal take with a light reverb on the chorus.
Violin bowing exercise: long slow strokes near the frog, then the spiccato study. Tuning the strings before each practice is essential.
The band rehearsal sounded tight on the chorus but the tempo dragged in the second verse. Count the drummer in and play the bridge with more dynamics.
Chord progression for the song is C, G, A minor, F. Try a melody over the top with a simple syncopated rhythm on the snare.
Voice warm up: lip trills, humming scales and a few sirens. Keep the breath support low and avoid pushing the high notes too loudly.
Listened to the mix on headphones and the vocals are too quiet compared to the synth pad. Automate the volume on the lead line through the second chorus.
